sloka: निरुन्धन्तमिवाकाशं चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ।कायवृद्धिं प्रवेगं च मम दृष्ट्वव राक्षसाः ॥५-१-२०४॥
transliteration: nirundhantamivākāśaṁ cakāra matimān matim ।kāyavṛddhiṁ pravegaṁ ca mama dṛṣṭvava rākṣasāḥ ॥5-1-204॥

translations.english: "As soon as the rakshasas see the swelling of my body and my speed," thought that great-minded one, "they will grow curious about me."
